title: Headset dead, but the receiver shows signal

complaints.says: My headset isn't working — but the receiver says it's getting a signal.

hints: RF bars mean the pack is on and on the right frequency. The audio meter tells you whether any sound is coming through.
cause: The WL1 body-pack was muted. It was still transmitting, so the receiver showed RF but no audio.
lesson: RF and audio are different things. RF means the link is up; no audio with good RF almost always means the pack is muted or the mic isn't plugged into the pack.
